question: A FIBA sanctioned game of basketball typically consists of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 quarters of 10 minutes each.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The playing time for a FIBA game is** 40 minutes, and that is divided into four 10-minute quarters.**
 
• FIBA quarters and clock time are shorter than that of the NBA by a total of 8 minutes.
 
• **Two-minute breaks follow the first and third quarters**, and the second quarter is followed by a **15-minute halftime break.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About FIBA:**

 
 
• The International Basketball Federation is an **association of public associations which governs the sport of basketball worldwide.**
 
• Firstly known as the Fédération Internationale de handbasket- ball amateur** (hence FIBA)**, in** 1989 **it dropped the word amateur from its name but retained the acronym.
 
• **FIBA defines the rules of basketball, specifies the outfit and installations needed, organizes transnational competitions, regulates the transfer of athletes across countries, and controls the appointment of transnational arbiters.**
 
• An aggregate of **213 public coalitions** are now members, organized since** 1989 into five zones Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, and Oceania.**
